inverse_consistency_rule: left/right inverse-pair consistency is a sanity check and is not used to override row-level geometry status.

status_rules.satisfied: left if subject-object center delta projects positively on selected_left_axis, right if it projects negatively, with no ambiguity flags
status_rules.uncertain: missing geometry, axis margin ambiguity, strong projected overlap, or orthogonal-axis dominance
status_rules.violated: opposite sign under the same non-ambiguous condition
